queries:
WITH counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM `order`
    GROUP BY account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT account_id, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) AS share
    FROM counts
),
avg_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_order_count,
       AVG(share) AS avg_share,
       AVG(share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_diff
FROM shares
WHERE share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order` WHERE account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE amount > (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM loan));
